title: Rhaponticin alleviates pancreatic acinar cell necrosis by attenuating oxidative stress via modulation of the HIF-1alpha signaling pathway.
authors: Xie, Xinyue; Yang, Pei; Wang, Shuai; Xu, Xingmeng; Wang, Liuhui; Li, Pin; Lu, Guotao; Chen, Weiwei; Sun, Runfeng; Zhang, Jingjing; Wang, Zhihao
journal: Redox report : communications in free radical research
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物Rhaponticin通过HIF-1alpha信号通路缓解胰腺腺泡细胞坏死，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: This study investigated the protective effects and mechanisms of rhaponticin (Rha) against acinar cell injury in acute pancreatitis (AP). METHODS: Pancreatic acinar cell injury was induced using multiple in vitro and in vivo AP models. The mitochondrial function, necrosis, and oxidative stress were assessed. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were applied to predict potential molecular targets, which were subsequently validated experimentally. The involvement of hypoxia-inducible factor 1-alpha (HIF-1alpha) signaling and necroptosis-related proteins, including receptor-interacting protein kinase 3 (RIP3) and phosphorylated mixed lineage kinase domain-like protein (p-MLKL), was further explored. Both pharmacological inhibition and siRNA-mediated knockdown were employed to verify the target specificity of Rha. RESULTS: Rha treatment significantly preserved mitochondrial function, reduced ROS, and alleviated pancreatic injury. Network pharmacology and molecular dockingresults identified HIF -1a as the key target of Rha. Consistently, Rha treatment markedly downregulated HIF-1alpha expression and inhibited necroptosis by suppressing the activation of RIP3 and p-MLKL. Notably, neither pharmacological inhibition nor siRNA-mediated knockdown of HIF-1alpha produced additional protective effects in the presence of Rha, indicating the involvement of HIF-1alpha in mediating its actions. CONCLUSION: Rha effectively attenuates acinar cell necrosis and oxidative via the HIF-1alpha-mediated necroptosis pathway, highlighting Rha as a promising therapeutic candidate for AP.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究探讨了土大黄苷（Rha）对急性胰腺炎（AP）中腺泡细胞损伤的保护作用及其机制。方法：使用多种体外和体内AP模型诱导胰腺腺泡细胞损伤，评估线粒体功能、坏死和氧化应激。通过网络药理学和分子对接预测潜在分子靶点，并随后通过实验验证。进一步探讨了缺氧诱导因子1-α（HIF-1α）信号通路及坏死性凋亡相关蛋白（包括受体相互作用蛋白激酶3（RIP3）和磷酸化混合谱系激酶结构域样蛋白（p-MLKL））的参与。采用药理学抑制和siRNA介导的敲低来验证Rha的靶点特异性。结果：Rha处理显著保护线粒体功能、减少活性氧（ROS）并减轻胰腺损伤。网络药理学和分子对接结果确定HIF-1α为Rha的关键靶点。一致地，Rha处理显著下调HIF-1α表达，并通过抑制RIP3和p-MLKL的激活来抑制坏死性凋亡。值得注意的是，在Rha存在的情况下，药理学抑制或siRNA介导的HIF-1α敲低均未产生额外的保护作用，表明HIF-1α参与介导其作用。结论：Rha通过HIF-1α介导的坏死性凋亡途径有效减轻腺泡细胞坏死和氧化应激，凸显Rha作为AP的有前景的治疗候选药物。
